recommendation_for_human_review: Either (a) accept the trade-off — bug tables live exclusively in qa.md and consumer agents fall back to monolith for bug content; or (b) loosen overlap tolerance to allow bug-table duplication into ba.md / ui-specialist.md / dev.md. Round 1 fail (functional incompleteness) and round 3 fail (overlap-uniqueness vs content-duplication tension) are inverse defects of the same axis.
